2652 Chestnut St, San Francisco, CA 94123 is a single family home that contains 5,155 sq ft and was built in 2014. It contains 5 bedrooms and 7 bathrooms. This home last sold for $8,800,000 in March 2025. 
 
The Zestimate for this house is $8,941,300. The Rent Zestimate for this home is $30,105/mo.
